notes: Retain original copyright and permission notices in copies or substantial portions.
Include license, relevant modification notices and any required upstream NOTICE attributions.
Charging a distribution fee is allowed; recipient rights to redistribution and appropriate corresponding source must be respected.
Not every arrangement with other licenses is automatically compatible.
Give attribution, license link and indicate modifications when appropriate.
Commercial use not licensed under standard BY-NC grant; separate permission may be negotiated.
An asset being free to download is not proof of commercial game reuse permission.

workflow_requirements: Inventory code, engine plugins, music, sound effects, fonts, art, game data and trademarks separately.
Read the license applicable to each exact version and asset, not the top-level repository name alone.
Preserve legally required notices and source access before sending binaries to buyers.
Reject a known noncommercial-only asset from an ordinary paid game absent separately documented permission.
Confirm that the publisher actually owns or holds necessary commercial rights for any custom contribution.
Review GPL compatibility, exception terms, static/dynamic linkage and content combinations separately when applicable.
limitations: The crosswalk describes general license families, not legal advice or actual rights clearance for any game's asset tree.
GNU GPL FAQ statements may vary with GPL version and delivery method; exact licenses and specific applicable provisions control.
Creative Commons deeds summarize terms; the linked full legal code controls.
No third-party source files, privately licensed assets, accounts or game sales were inspected.
